sentences.en: The continuing conflict between the different movements deepened even further.
sentences.zh: 不同运动之间的持续冲突进一步加深。

sentences.en: He became more interested in continuing his studies of Berber.
sentences.zh: 他对继续研究柏柏尔语的兴趣越来越大。

sentences.en: I will play Sudoku then instead of continuing to bother you.
sentences.zh: 我将玩数独游戏而不是继续打扰你。

senses.zh: 继续的，连续的，持续的v.继续，连续( continue的现在分词 ),持续,逗留,停留
